title: Module 4 - Financial Statement Analysis and Financial Modeling

assets.alt_text: Financial modeling map linking income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, and equity while separating reported, reclassified, normalized, and forecast evidence layers.
assets.prompt: Create a 1920x1080 PNG, 16:9. Academic three-statement modeling map for Module 4. Link the income statement, balance sheet, cash flow statement, and equity roll-forward with explicit directional arrows and a final balance and cash reconciliation check. Above the statements, show four evidence layers in order: reported, reclassified, normalized, forecast. Keep labels short and exact. Off-white background, navy linework, teal operating links, muted-blue balance-sheet links, amber forecast highlights, coral control-break warnings, and a 7% safe margin. No company logos, fake filings, or invented numbers.
production_notes: Generated from code so accounting identities, layer order, and reconciliation directions remain exact.
